opportunities.point: The company hopes to perform as well as the first half or slightly better in the full year FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We are at the end of the second month of the third quarter. Okay? So, we are doing equally good and we hope to perform as good as the first half or even a little better." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Revenue from the new facility is expected to start coming in from the first quarter of the next financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company started construction of a new factory unit in YEIDA in 2023.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Construction of new factory unit in YEIDA started 2023" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Sacheerome acquired land in YEIDA in 2020 for establishing a new manufacturing unit.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Allotment of Land in YEIDA for the purpose of establishment of new manufacturing unit 2020" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The shares trade under the model's intrinsic value.

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The fragrance and flavour industry continues to experience strong demand driven by consumption in FMCG, food and beverage, and personal care segments.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company experienced strong performance driven by healthy demand across different product categories.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We delivered a strong performance, driven by healthy demand across different product categories, and with the enhanced product range." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company's current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos, and the new capacity will add another 20 lakh kilos.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So, as you are aware, our current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos and in the new capacity, we are doing adding another 20 lakh kilos which will make our total capacity to 27,60,000 kilos." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The new capacity will be almost five times the current capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "And our new capacity will have 5x (almost) than the current capacity." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

First of all, there was a fire in BSF, then there was COVID, then, China products, and sometimes, due to the climatic conditions, due to some reasons, there is scarcity."
